title: Part Thirty-One: When It Was Used at Home

sections.brief: Builds on us10_us (Church/FISA not repeated): SHAMROCK (~150k/month, ended May 1975), MINARET (~1,650 Americans incl. King, Ali, Wicker, Buchwald, Sens. Church (D) and Baker (R); NSA historian 'disreputable if not outright illegal'), COINTELPRO (1956-April 1971; Media burglary 8 Mar 1971; King letter 21 Nov 1964), CHAOS (Rockefeller: ~300,000 names, 7,200 files, 'unlawfully exceeded'), Army surveillance and Laird v. Tatum (1972), IRS SSS (~8,000/3,000); what stopped each (exposure, then oversight); Stellar Wind (1.2% IG figure); FBI 702 query misuse 2020-21 across the spectrum. Figures: time, compare

Terms defined (metadata, 702, EO 12333, exploit); 215 lifecycle (2015 end, 685M deletion 2018, expiry 15 Mar 2020); PRISM (company denials; directives) and Upstream ('about' ended 28 Apr 2017); 702 lapse 12 Jun 2026, certifications to 17 Mar 2027 (link us10_us); XKEYSCORE (PCLOB 2024), MUSCULAR, Tempora/BBW v UK (2021); CIA 12333 bulk programme (Feb 2022); ANT catalogue NOT a Snowden doc; Vault 7, Schulte 40 yrs, CIA task force 'woefully lax'; bought data (ODNI CAI report; Patel 18 Mar 2026). Figures: compare, time

Snowden (3 counts; Russian citizen 26 Sep 2022; DOJ civil judgment >$5.2M 29 Sep 2020, not SEC; no pardon as of Oct 2026; Gabbard 2025), Manning (35 yrs, commuted), Assange (18 counts, plea 26 Jun 2024), Winner (63 months), Hale (45 months), Schulte; vs Clapper ('not wittingly', 'clearly erroneous', limitation ran 12 Mar 2018) and CIA-SSCI search (no discipline); harm argued both ways (HPSCI, 2011 unredacted cables; Holder, PolitiFact, Manglona); asymmetry documented, motive not; worst-case reading tested (documented / probable / not supported) with record running against it. Figures: compare, compare
